objective: Restore visible KL admin Release Now/Release Status and Reject controls on narrow Android screens, without changing chapter approval, publication, or Season 2 rewards.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: The KL Reader component on main and staging/season2-all-updates-20261119 was inspected and both displayed the same nonwrapping admin action row; approved chapters put 5-question buttons between Approve and Reject/Release, pushing release controls offscreen on the supplied Android screenshots. The staging branch is not the installed app nor proof of current production OTA. No production publication or backend state was changed.
chosenApproach: Place Approve, Release Now/Release Status and Reject in their own flex-wrapped, short admin action row. Render release preflight and reject confirmation directly afterward, before the separate approved-chapter quiz buttons and long answer review. Preserve existing server-side release guards and two-click confirmation unchanged.
selectionRationale: Approve appears and Release Now disappears specifically on approved chapters containing quiz buttons; original parent row is nowrap. Draft chapter without quiz shows the Release button.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Repair KL admin actions overflowing the mobile chapter card while preserving server-side approval and publication security.
preservedBehaviors: Only verified System Admin users can inspect or trigger chapter admin actions.
Every release still requires fresh server status, ready quiz, approval preflight, explicit confirmation, exact server episode ID and post-release verification.
No chapter, scene, question, points, rewards, or production release state changes occur from the layout fix.

preserveBehaviors: Existing valid KL reader, chapter accessibility, and manuscript previews remain unchanged.
Release Now does not automatically publish a chapter when displayed.
Season 2 remains completely isolated from production.
acceptanceChecks: Approved chapter with quiz tools shows Approve, Release Now and Reject in a wrapping row on a narrow Android screen.
Release preflight appears directly under controls before quiz answer review.
Existing chapter release server guard and two-click confirmation are unchanged.
Run focused KL Node tests, TypeScript, Android export and staging release gate before publishing.
Staging OTA only; never send Season 2 changes to production before December 6, 2026.
releaseTarget: Android staging-user channel, preview environment; production untouched.
alternativeApproaches: Add flexWrap only to the original single row (rejected: 5-question controls still clutter and obscure release on narrow phones).
Always show the release button by skipping approval state or backend preflight (rejected: unauthorized or incomplete chapter could publish).
Add horizontal scrolling to the action row (rejected: the button would still be visually hidden and hard to discover).
